declared.freeze: screen and replicate need a committed model_specs/cb8_v1.json carrying h_analysis_rules_sha256 and h_data_rules_sha256 equal to the code's
interpretations: Market-days: snapshot rows with status 'ok' whose snapshot time h lies in the stage's window; the print request status must be 'ok' (capped / failed -> unavailable, counted). c_j is recomputed from the stored top-20 holders and the stored /oi value at t_f with cb8_holders.concentration (the hashed data rule).

Exit: taker SELL (side -1) of token j by the rank-1 holder of j at h, ts in (h + 60 s, h + 24 h], c_j >= 0.5, token price in [0.03, 0.97]. A print that qualifies under two consecutive snapshots (overlapping windows) is ONE exit, kept with the earliest snapshot.

Control: from the exit's own market-day stored prints (stored in full because c_j >= 0.5): taker SELL of token j, price in [0.03, 0.97] (the exit's price rule, applied to controls too), wallet hash present and not among the top-5 holders of either token at h, |ts - ts_exit| <= 6 h; nearest in time within 0.5x-2x of the exit's size, else within 0.25x-4x, else none (exit excluded, counted); ties by earlier ts; without replacement per market, exits in time order.

Mark M_j(u): the FIRST complete capture of the market-day's marks with received_utc in [u, u + 2.5 h]; if its spread (ask - bid of YES) exceeds 5c or a quote is missing, the mark is unavailable (the literal 'spread <= 5c at that capture'; no search for a tighter later capture). Token 1 mid = 1 - YES mid.
mo(x) = M_j(ts_x + 2 h) - p_x; unit = matched pair, value mo(exit) - mo(control); a pair with either mark unavailable is unavailable (counted; worst case).
Cluster ways: Gamma event (event id, else market id), UTC day of the exit, holder (exit wallet hash). Day way under A-C1.
Route gate (binding at the point estimate): mean mo(exit) >= +0.5c with no rebate. The with-rebate version is NOT computable: the H data store no fee category (reported as unavailable).

GH (>= 150 matched exits with both marks, >= 50 events, >= 15 days, >= 30 holders; non-sports) is applied at both stages on the stage's own units; a fail -> not testable, p = 1, counted; no window extension. If no rank-1 hash of a concentrated token ever appears among the stored print wallets -> not testable (source).

Label-shuffle placebo: one fair coin per holder x market x snapshot-day block flips the sign of every pair in the block (label swap); advance = the p condition (floor off); 200 draws, seed 8183; calibrated iff the advance rate <= 1.5%.

Concentration attribution: H1_low = the same contrast for rank-1 exits of tokens with c < 0.2. Controls exist only where the market-day was stored in full (the other token had c >= 0.5), so H1_low may have few or no units; none -> unverified (never credited; does not block).

Robustness (i): the next-but-one capture as the mark (the SECOND capture with received_utc >= u in the market-day's marks, spread <= 5c at that capture); sign and >= half of H1. (ii) top 5 events / days dropped: p condition and floor. (iii) exit-size-weighted sign. (iv) months with >= 50 pairs: reported only. (v) worst case: unavailable pairs enter with contrast 0; sign and p condition. (vi) exits only from h + 15 min (controls re-matched): sign and >= half of H1.

Stage 2 uses p < alpha2 / k_used wherever Stage 1 uses 0.01; k_used = 1 + the other CB8 tests that advanced or have no final Stage-1 file yet. Window 2 must start at or after the first commit of the freeze spec + 2 h (checked when committed files are required).
BY triage label: p <= q / (m H_m), m = battery2.cumulative_count() at run time. Batch-Holm label k1 = 3, alpha 0.01; tests without a final file enter as p = 1.
MDE: (z_0.99 + z_0.80) x 6c x sqrt(2 / n_pairs) (design SD and deff); never used to change a floor.
